							local Magnitude = (vPosition - v1254.Position).Magnitude
							local n27 = 0

							if v1258 then
								local Magnitude2 = (vPosition - v1258.Position).Magnitude

							end

							end
						end
					end

				end

			end

	local function u471()

		if GunDrop then
			local Character = u305.Character
			local v1073 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if v1073 then
				local v1075

				if not GunDrop:IsA("BasePart") then
					local v1074 = GunDrop:FindFirstChild("Handle") or (GunDrop:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or GunDrop.PrimaryPart)

					v1075 = v1074 and v1074.Position or GunDrop:GetModelCFrame().Position
				else
					v1075 = GunDrop.Position
				end

				if v1075 then
					local CFrame5 = v1073.CFrame

					v1073.CFrame = CFrame.new(v1075 + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
					task.wait(0.2)
					v1073.CFrame = CFrame5
					u304("Teleported to gun!", "success")

					return
				end

				u304("Position not found.", "error")

				return
			end

			return
		end

		u304("No gun on map!", "error")
	end

local u523 = v394

v182("Farm", "Auto Farm Coins", "Teleports to safest coin periodically", false, function(p110)
	u45 = p110

	if not p110 then
		u406()
		u524("Auto Farm OFF")

		return
	end

	if u47 then
		u47:Disconnect()
		u47 = nil
	end

	u47 = u519.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if u45 then
			local timestamp = tick()

			if not (timestamp - n28 < n8) then
				n28 = timestamp

				local v1556 = u520()

				if v1556 then
					local Character = u521.Character
					local v1558 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if v1558 then
						local Position = v1556.Position
						local v1560 = u522()

						if not v1560 or (v1560.Position - Position).Magnitude >= n9 then
							v1558.CFrame = CFrame.new(v1556.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
						end
					end
				end

				if u46 then
					u523()
				end

				return
			end

			return
		end
	end)
	u524("Auto Farm ON!", "success")
end)

local function u543()
	if u20 then
		u20 = false
		u326.Brightness = u327.Brightness
		u326.GlobalShadows = u327.GlobalShadows
		u326.Ambient = u327.Ambient
		u326.OutdoorAmbient = u327.OutdoorAmbient

		for _, child in pairs(u326:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BloomEffect") or child:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or child:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	u19 = true
	pcall(function()
		settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
	end)
	pcall(function()
		setfpscap(9999)
	end)
	u326.GlobalShadows = false
	u326.Brightness = 2

	for _, descendant in ipairs(u328:GetDescendants()) do
		local _pcall = pcall
		local u1112 = descendant

		pcall(function()
			u329(u1112)
		end)
	end

	if u325 then
		u325:Disconnect()
	end

	u325 = u328.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
		task.wait(0.1)
		local u1525 = descendant

		pcall(function()
			u329(u1525)
		end)
	end)
	u330.Visible = true
	u331("Low Graphics ON", "success")
end
